present_illness.present_illness: Wisdom tooth inflammation has been controlled after local treatment

past_history.present_illness: Wisdom tooth inflammation has been controlled after local treatment

oral_examination.oral_examination: 48 Mesial vertical impaction, mucosa covering the distal maxillary surface, no abnormal color, no redness, swelling, or congestion. Nothing special.

source_handle: 48 Local povidone-iodine disinfection, alveolar nerve block anesthesia with lidocaine hydrochloride, and infiltration anesthesia with bistriol around the wisdom teeth. After the anesthesia takes effect, separate the gums, loosen them, and remove them with tooth extraction forceps. Routinely scratch the tooth extraction wound and suture to stop bleeding
